card.label: H.J.Res. 130
card.summary: H.J. Res. 130 is a joint resolution that nullifies a Bureau of Land Management rule from November 2024. That rule had amended the 2015 resource management plan for the Buffalo Field Office in Wyoming to make no federal coal available for future leasing. By nullifying the rule, this legislation requires the Bureau of Land Management to follow the 2015 plan instead, thereby making federal coal resources in that planning area available for future leasing again.
